notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pegasus dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Repeat.
